tonga.title: Flag of the Kingdom of Tonga

colors.note: Represents the blood of Christ shed on the cross
The canton and the couped cross representing purity

desc:
- Red field with a white rectangle in the upper hoist canton containing a red couped (Greek) cross
- Adopted on 4 November 1875 under the Tongan Constitution proclaimed by King George Tupou I
trivia:
- Tonga is the only Pacific Island nation that was never formally colonised, though it was a British-protected state from 1900 to 1970
- The constitution of 1875 mandates that the flag can never be changed, making it one of the most legally entrenched national symbols
- The cross reflects the Christian foundation that King George Tupou I wove into the constitutional monarchy
